R44AX.name: BINARY_IMPLICATION_CONGRUENCE
R44AX.head: 9c44f66de3f7ab39e54391ece0c4282077e50570
R44AX.primitive: Use SCC equivalence in the explicit width<=2 implication graph to quotient forced-equivalent literals exactly.
R44AX.novel_effect: Can remove variables even when the R44AW sign-flip translation group is trivial.
R44AX.universal_barrier: Exact-width-3 rigid SAT/UNSAT families have empty binary core.
R44AX.semantic_completion_firewall: Complete arbitrary semantic literal-equivalence detection is coNP-hard.

R44AY.name: LOCAL_AFFINE_CONSEQUENCE_CLOSURE
R44AY.head: d4cc24433a083287b30c60271d04937e0f85db38
R44AY.primitive: For every <=3-variable support bundle, enumerate the local relation, extract every valid GF(2) affine consequence, close globally by Gaussian elimination, and authorize only forced units/equivalences.
R44AY.novel_effect: Consumes exact-width-3 rigid gadgets that have neither sign-flip symmetry nor binary SCC congruence.
R44AY.anti_drift_from_R43A: R43A exact affine/XOR bundle recognition is distinct from R44AY sound affine-consequence extraction from arbitrary non-affine OR bundles.
R44AY.universal_barrier: Single-support linear exact-3-CNF formulas yield no local affine equations; known unsatisfiable linear 3-CNFs and satisfiable linear families give fixed points.

R44AZ.name: FAILED_2SAT_COFACTOR_CERTIFICATE
R44AZ.head: d58af4de77e31fee91d7554ff796f09f60cd89d7
R44AZ.primitive: Probe one variable value, but grant authority only when the width<=2 subformula of that cofactor is exactly UNSAT by SCC; then choose the opposite value safely.
R44AZ.novel_effect: Moves formulas simultaneously fixed by R44AW, R44AX and R44AY, without recursively solving either arbitrary cofactor.
R44AZ.universal_barrier: On exact-width-3 linear CNF, all binary clauses created by one cofactor have pairwise disjoint residual supports and are always jointly satisfiable; thus SAT/UNSAT linear families are fixed points.

current_residual_core.name: QUADRUPLE_RIGID_CORE

current_residual_core.next_question: Find one polynomially computable exact invariant that strictly progresses on the quadruple-rigid core without DP, recursive branching, generic proof search, bounded-local repackaging, or hiding SAT in terminal evaluation.
